<form>
  <div class='row'>
    <div class='large-6 columns'>
      <label>Target File</label><input type='text' of-id='buildScript.targetFile' value='{{buildScript.targetFile}}' placeholder='target file to be built' />
    </div>
    <div class='large-6 columns'>
      <label>Version File</label><input type='text' of-id='buildScript.versionFile' value='{{buildScript.versionFile}}' placeholder='location and name of versioned file' />
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class='row'>
    <div class='large-12 columns'>
      !!Build Steps
      <table>
        <thead>
        <tr>
          <td>Action</td><td>FileName</td>
        </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
        <tr of-repeatFor="step in buildScript.steps">
         	<td>{{step.action}}</td><td>{{step.fileName}}</td>
        </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class='row'>
    <div class='large-12 columns'>
      <label>Source File</label><input type='text' of-id='buildScriptNewSourceFile' placeholder='source file to be applended' /> [{Button title="Add" function="addAppendStep"}]
    </div>
  </div>
</form>
[{Button title="Save" function="saveBuildScript"}]
